subject: Clarify POC metrics, timeline, and exec readout window
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@healthlytix.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: POC follow-up — proposed success metrics and timeline

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier — great context on the fraud-detection workflow and the throughput you need (peak ~120 req/s, avg 35 req/s). Per our conversation I wanted to put a short, actionable POC plan on email so we can align owners and exec readout timing.

Proposed POC overview (2-week focused run):
- Goal: Validate inference latency and end-to-end accuracy delta vs. your current LSTM pipeline under realistic traffic.
- Success metrics (primary):
  - 95th percentile latency < 120ms for 1k-token average prompts
  - End-to-end FPR improvement >= 10% or precision lift >= 6% on the sampled cohort
  - Cost per 1M tokens at or below $X (we'll pin this after a sample run)
- Success metrics (secondary):
  - No model-serving incidents > 5 minutes
  - Smooth KV cache warmup within 30 minutes of steady traffic

Proposed owners and next steps:
1) Redwood: Dev will provision a dedicated trial route, add KV caching and set batching heuristics (Dev).
2) HealthyTix: Emma/Carlos to provide a 48-hour anonymized traffic sample and the evaluation script (Emma).
3) Joint: We run a 48-hour calibration followed by a 7-day scoring window. After that we schedule an exec readout for go/no-go.

Tentative timeline:
- Oct 19: receive sample data and evaluation script
- Oct 20: calibration run (48 hours) starts
- Oct 23-29: scoring window
- Oct 30: exec readout (30–45 min) + decision
Could you confirm: (a) the listed success metrics capture what you care about, (b) the timeline works for the HealthyTix exec team, and (c) who should be the exec attendees (we usually expect a single product or engineering leader + procurement if procurement needs to sign off).

I attached a short eval matrix and proof-of-workflow doc; we'll finalize pricing details after the calibration pass.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: poc-eval-matrix.xlsx, redwood-proof-of-workflow.pdf
From: Emma Li <emma@healthlytix.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@healthlytix.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up — proposed success metrics and timeline

Thanks Rafael — this is really helpful and aligned with our needs. A few clarifications/questions from our side: 

1) Success metrics: the precision lift threshold is the most important for the product team; FPR improvement is great to have. Can we make the precision lift >= 6% the primary KPI and treat latency as a strict SLO (95p < 120ms) rather than a success KPI?
2) Data: we'll upload a 72-hour anonymized sample instead of 48 hours (gives better representation). Expect upload to your Drive folder by EOD Oct 19.
3) Evaluation script: we'll share a scorer that calculates precision/recall and the cohort segmentation we care about. Please confirm the format (CSV with id,pred,label,timestamp).
4) Exec readout: Oct 30 is tentative — our VP Product, Lina Zhou, is available Oct 30 after 2pm PT; procurement (Carlos) will join but may need a separate quick call for the contract path if the readout is positive.

Also adding one non-functional requirement — we need an audit trace for inference inputs for compliance; can Redwood provide a short export (CSV) of request IDs and timestamps at the end of the scoring window?

If you confirm the change to primary KPI and the audit export, we'll greenlight the 72-hour upload tonight.

— Emma
Emma Li
Head of Product, HealthyTix

Attachment: poc-eval-matrix_healthlytix_v1.xlsx (uploaded)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@healthlytix.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-18T17:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC follow-up — proposed success metrics and timeline

Emma — perfect, thanks for the clarifications. Quick confirmations: 

- We will flip the primary KPI to precision lift >= 6% and treat 95p latency < 120ms as a strict SLO.
- Data format accepted: CSV with columns id, pred, label, timestamp — Dev will validate the scorer against our harness.
- Audit trace: yes — we can provide an export of request_id,timestamp,route,model_version at the end of scoring. We'll mark this as part of the acceptance criteria.

Updated timeline (reflecting 72-hour sample + your exec availability):
- Oct 19 (EOD): HealthyTix uploads 72-hour sample + scorer
- Oct 20–22: calibration and small-scale runs (Dev)
- Oct 23–29: scoring window (7 days)
- Oct 30, 2:30–3:15pm PT: exec readout (Lina + Carlos + Rafael + Monica) — can you confirm Lina's invite?; if Lina needs a different slot we can flex Oct 31 morning.

Next operational asks for HealthyTix: please confirm Drive path and share any IP redaction notes. For our side, Monica will prepare a compact readout deck (<=10 slides) and pricing summary; I'll loop Legal if we need any custom T&Cs for the POC.

I'll send a calendar invite for the tentative Oct 30 window once you confirm Lina.

Best — Rafael

Subject: Re: POC follow-up — pricing and contractual bits to prep

Quick note from procurement side — copying the pricing summary in case useful for the exec readout:

- Trial pricing: 2-week POC covered under sandbox credits (no charge), but we will bill observed usage for refund accounting if scope extends.
- Post-trial: standard Enterprise Start plan (monthly committed capacity) with optional dedicated pool.
- If exec signs off for production, procurement asks for 60-day pilot agreement with a follow-on reserved commit or month-to-month credits for the first 3 months.

Attached is a short pricing-summary.pdf that Monica will use during the readout. Rafael — flagging that Legal might want to pre-approve the 60-day pilot clause; happy to introduce if needed.

— Monica
Senior Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Exec readout confirmed — Oct 30, 2:30pm PT + next steps

Lina / Emma / Carlos — thanks for confirming availability. I've booked the 2:30–3:15pm PT slot on Oct 30 and sent a calendar invite to Lina. Agenda (30–45 min):
1) 5m — POC scope and calibration overview (Rafael)
2) 10m — scoring results preview & primary KPIs (Monica)
3) 10m — infra/ops readout and audit/export capability (Dev)
4) 5–10m — go/no-go and contract path (Monica/Rafael)

Prep items before the readout:
- HealthyTix: upload 72-hour sample + scorer to the Drive folder by EOD Oct 19 (Emma)
- Redwood: calibration run logs + preliminary cost estimate by Oct 25 (Dev/Monica)
- Both: confirm exec attendees and any last-minute compliance asks (audit fields)

If the readout is positive we will issue a non-binding Statement of Work and DocuSign package outlining the 60-day pilot terms. I'll circulate the DocuSign link the day after the readout to speed procurement.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/DS-4832-POC
